title: How long Zscaler keeps the logs of the products on the Logs and Fair Use pages, and where it stores them

prose.text: {{zia-logs}} The Client Connector page lists different ZIA storage regions {{divergence:zia-storage-regions}}. {{zia-iot}} {{zia-nss}} Retention for the other products is by product below; the hub is [[shared.logs-fair-use]].

prose.label: ZPA.
prose.text: {{zpa-retention}} The Extended Retention list names Inspection logs where the standard list names AppProtection logs {{gap:zpa-appprotection-vs-inspection}}. {{zpa-storage}} {{zpa-pra}} {{zpa-zms-ml}}

prose.label: ZDX.
prose.text: {{zdx-logs}} Which subscription gets two weeks and which two days is open {{gap:zdx-subscription-mapping}}. {{zdx-diagnostics}} {{zdx-features}}

prose.label: Client and connector products.
prose.text: {{zcc}} Several pages state retention as a floor with no upper bound {{gap:at-least-bounds}}. {{cbc}} {{ztg}} {{cellular}} {{zsdk}} Storage location is not stated on some of these pages {{gap:storage-not-stated}}. AI Guard's page gives no storage location either {{gap:storage-not-stated}}.

prose.label: Agentic SecOps, identity and exposure.
prose.text: {{agentic-secops}} The page lists individual products with differing periods {{gap:agentic-secops-retention-range}}. {{agentic-platform}} {{agentic-soc}} {{identity-protection}} {{aem}} {{uvm}} {{breach-predictor}} {{easm}} {{threat-hunting}}

checks.do: The retention window and storage choice the product's own Logs page states: ZIA six months, ZPA at least 14 days or six months with Extended Retention, Client Connector at least 90 days; ZIA storage regions differ between the ZIA and Client Connector pages.

auth-audit.statement: For Authentication Service, Audit Logs are kept for a rolling six months during the subscription term, and the deployment process lets you pick United States, European Union or India for storage.

quotes: Zscaler retains Audit Log information for a rolling period of six months during the subscription term.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the Audit Logs stored in the United States, European Union, or India.

dspm.statement: DSPM keeps logs describing active cloud resources or issues for the subscription duration; once a resource is gone from the CSP it keeps them a rolling 180 days. When the subscription term ends or expires, it deletes the logs after the 180-day retention cycle or earlier upon request. Storage is US or EU, chosen at deployment.

quotes: All logs that describe active cloud resources or issues are retained by Zscaler for the duration of the subscription.
Once the resources are no longer present in the CSP, DSPM maintains the logs for a rolling period of 180 days
When the subscription term ends or expires, Zscaler deletes the logs after the 180-day retention cycle or earlier upon request.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.

zpc.statement: ZPC keeps logs describing active cloud resources or issues for the subscription duration; once a resource is gone from the CSP it keeps them a rolling 180 days. When the subscription term ends or expires, it deletes the logs after the 180-day retention cycle. Storage is US or EU, chosen at deployment.

quotes: All logs that describe active cloud resources or issues are retained by Zscaler for the duration of the subscription.
Once the resources are no longer present in the CSP, ZPC maintains the logs for a rolling period of 180 days
When the subscription term ends or expires, Zscaler deletes the logs after the 180-day retention cycle.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.

zdx-logs.statement: ZDX logs are kept for a rolling period of at least two weeks or two days, depending on the subscription. Storage is in the United States, European Union, Australia, Canada, Singapore or India, or in the region you select if you subscribe to the ZDX Data Residency feature.

quotes: Zscaler retains the logs on a rolling period of at least two weeks or two days during your subscription term, depending on your subscription.
Logs are stored in the United States, European Union, Australia, Canada, Singapore, or India.
If you subscribe to the ZDX Data Residency feature, the logs are stored in the geographic region selected by you.

zdx-diagnostics.statement: ZDX Diagnostics reports are retained for a rolling at least two weeks or two days, depending on the subscription; Diagnostics might capture packet capture files and process-level device telemetry (ZDX Deep Tracing data).

quotes: Zscaler retains the ZDX Diagnostics reports on a rolling period of at least two weeks or two days during your subscription term, depending on your subscription.
Diagnostics might result in the capture and storage of packet capture files, as well as additional telemetry about user devices
including software process level information of the devices (i.e., ZDX Deep Tracing data)

zdx-features.statement: ZDX feature retention: Managed Monitoring logs 30 days, Network Intelligence aggregated logs one year, Remediation script results and telemetry 180 days (authorized users can delete script results at any time via the ZDX Admin Portal), Snapshots 90 days.

quotes: ZDX Managed Monitoring: Logs are retained by Zscaler for a period of 30 days.
ZDX Network Intelligence: Aggregated logs are retained by Zscaler for a period of one year.
All script results and telemetry collected through this feature are retained by Zscaler for 180 days.
Authorized users can delete script results at any time via the ZDX Admin Portal.
ZDX Snapshots are retained by Zscaler for 90 days.
ZDX Remediation allows for the execution of remote scripts on user devices.

zia-logs.statement: ZIA logs are retained for a rolling six months during the subscription term; storage is chosen at deployment as either the United States or the European Union and Switzerland.

quotes: Zscaler retains the logs for a rolling period of six months during the term of subscription.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union and Switzerland.

zia-iot.statement: For IoT Advanced Security, unauthenticated, non-user-identifying web logs associated with the customer at org level are retained a rolling three months and stored in the United States.

quotes: For the IoT Advanced Security service, unauthenticated, non-user-identifying web logs that are associated with the customer at the org level will be retained by Zscaler for a rolling period of three months during the term of subscription.
For the IoT Advanced Security service, the logs will be stored in the United States.

zia-nss.statement: Per the ZIA logs page, Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) streams logs in real time within your premises and can send them to multiple systems, allowing retention for any period.

quotes: Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) allows you to stream the logs in real-time within your premises.
these logs can also be sent to multiple systems, allowing the retention of the logs for any period.

zpa-retention.statement: ZPA retains User Activity, User Status, AppProtection and App Connector logs a rolling at least 14 days and audit logs a rolling six months; with the Extended Retention feature, User Activity, User Status, Inspection and App Connector logs are kept a rolling six months.

quotes: Zscaler retains User Activity, User Status, AppProtection, and App Connector log information for a rolling period of at least 14 days during the subscription term.
Zscaler retains audit log information for a rolling period of six months during the subscription term.

If you subscribe to the Extended Retention feature, Zscaler retains User Activity, User Status, Inspection, and App Connector log information for a rolling period of six months during the subscription term.

zpa-storage.statement: ZPA logs are stored in the United States or the European Union, chosen at deployment, and can be viewed or streamed in real time with the Log Streaming Service (LSS).

quotes: During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.
You can also view your logs or stream logs in real-time using the Log Streaming Service (LSS).

zpa-pra.statement: With Session Recording for PRA configured, session recordings are retained for one year during the subscription term and are encrypted and stored in the geographic region of the tenant.

quotes: If you configure the Session Recording for PRA, session recordings will be retained by Zscaler for a period of one year during the term of subscription.
the session recordings will be encrypted and stored in the geographical region in which your tenant is located.

zpa-zms-ml.statement: For Zscaler Microsegmentation machine-learning recommendations (with opt-in), flow logs and resource inventory data are stored a rolling period of up to 180 days to generate recommendations.

quotes: If you subscribe to Zscaler Microsegmentation machine-learning recommendations (and opt-in to receive these recommendations)
Zscaler will store flow logs and resource inventory data for a rolling period of up to 180 days.
This data will be used for generating recommendations.

adaptive-access.statement: Adaptive Access Engine keeps Signal History a rolling 90 days and Audit Log information a rolling 6 months during the subscription term.

quotes: Zscaler retains the Signal History for a rolling period of 90 days during the term of the subscription.
Zscaler retains Audit Log information for a rolling period of 6 months during the subscription term.

agentic-secops.statement: Agentic SecOps Platform and Agentic SOC logs are retained for a rolling period of up to six months depending on the subscription, with individual products possibly differing; storage is US or EU, chosen at deployment, and storage locations for individual products may differ.

quotes: Depending on your subscription, Zscaler retains Agentic SecOps Platform and Agentic SOC logs for a rolling period of up to six months during your subscription term.
Retention for individual products may differ and are listed below.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.
Storage locations for individual products may differ and are listed below.

agentic-platform.statement: Platform-level retention: Mapping Copilot prompts and responses 90 days as session history; Configuration Audit Logs are kept on the platform 180 days with the preceding 90 days available in the Admin Portal.

quotes: For the Mapping Copilot feature, prompts and responses are stored by Zscaler for 90 days as part of the session history.

Configuration Audit Logs: Configuration Audit Logs are available in the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal and by subscribing to export to S3/GCP on an hourly basis. Audit logs are retained on the platform for 180 days with the preceding 90 days available in the Admin Portal.

agentic-soc.statement: Agentic SOC retains incident and alert information for one year, comments for up to one year while the related incident remains, asset/user/device information a rolling up to one year, and Agentic SOC Assist prompts and responses for 30 days.

quotes: the information related to such incidents is stored by Zscaler for one year.
your comments are stored by Zscaler for up to one year, as long as the related incident remains on the platform.
Information related to alerts identified by Agentic SOC is stored for one year.
Information regarding assets, users, and devices is retained for a rolling period of up to one year.
Prompts and responses are stored by Zscaler for 30 days as part of the session history.
Agentic SOC Assist is the AI-powered assistant in Agentic SOC.

ai-asset-infra.statement: AI Asset Management for AI Infrastructure keeps logs describing active cloud resources or issues for the subscription duration, then a rolling 180 days once the resource is gone from the CSP; logs are stored in the United States.

quotes: Once the resources are no longer present in the CSP, AI Asset Management for AI Infrastructure retains the logs for a rolling period of 180 days during your subscription term.
Logs are stored in the United States.
All logs that describe active cloud resources or issues are retained by Zscaler for the duration of the subscription.

ai-asset-platform.statement: AI Asset Management Platform logs are kept a rolling six months; storage is chosen at deployment as United States or European Union and Switzerland.

quotes: Zscaler retains the logs on a rolling period of six months during your subscription term.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union and Switzerland.

ai-guard.statement: AI Guard logs are stored for 90 days.

quotes: Logs are stored for a period of 90 days.

ai-scanning.statement: AI Scanning Platform operation metadata logs (timestamps, API request IDs, API status codes) are kept a rolling 28 days; storage is US or EU chosen at deployment.

quotes: Metadata logs related to the operation of the AI Scanning Platform Service, such as timestamps, API request IDs, and API status codes are retained for a rolling period of 28 days.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.

ai-scanning-delete.statement: During the subscription you may delete data sets such as uploaded CSV files from the Admin Portal; data that cannot be removed there can be removed by manual deletion on request.

quotes: During the term of your subscription, you may delete specific data sets (i.e., CSV files you uploaded to the platform) directly from the Admin Portal.
For data that cannot be removed via the Admin Portal, you may submit a request for manual deletion by our team.

aem.statement: AEM logs are retained a rolling period up to a year, Mapping Copilot prompts and responses 90 days, and logs are stored in the United States.

quotes: Zscaler retains the logs on a rolling period up to a year during your subscription term.
For the Mapping Copilot feature, prompts and responses are stored by Zscaler for 90 days as part of the session history.
Logs are stored in the United States.

breach-predictor.statement: Breach Predictor logs are retained a rolling period of up to a year depending on the subscription SKU; AI Assist prompts and responses are kept 30 days; storage is EU or India, chosen at deployment.

quotes: Zscaler retains Breach Predictor logs for a rolling period of up to a year during your subscription term, depending on your subscription's SKU.
For the Breach Predictor AI Assist feature, prompts and responses are stored by Zscaler for 30 days as part of the session history.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the European Union or India.

business-insights.statement: Business Insights SaaS Application Usage Logs and Workplace Insights Logs are retained a rolling period of up to three years and stored in the European Union.

quotes: Zscaler retains SaaS Application Usage Logs and Workplace Insights Logs for a rolling period of up to three years during your subscription term.
SaaS Application Usage Logs and the Workplace Insights Logs are stored in the European Union.

cellular.statement: Zscaler Cellular (SIM and Cellular Edge) logs are retained a rolling up to 180 days and audit logs a rolling six months, viewable or streamable via NSS; storage is US or EU chosen at deployment.

quotes: Zscaler retains log information for a rolling period of up to 180 days during the subscription term.
Zscaler retains audit log information for a rolling period of six months during the subscription term.
You can also view your logs or stream logs in real-time using the Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS).
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.

zcc.statement: Client Connector logs are retained a rolling period of at least 90 days and stored in the same location as your ZIA logs.

quotes: Zscaler retains log information for a rolling period of at least 90 days during the subscription term.
Your logs are stored in the same location as your Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) logs

cbc.statement: Cloud & Branch Connector logs are retained a rolling six months.

quotes: Your logs for Zscaler Cloud & Branch Connector are retained by Zscaler for a rolling six month period during your subscription.

ztg.statement: Zero Trust Gateway logs are retained a rolling six months.

quotes: Your logs for Zero Trust Gateway are retained by Zscaler for a rolling six month period during your subscription.

deception.statement: Deception logs are retained a rolling 12 months; Zscaler deletes them within 30 days after the term ends. Storage is US, EU or Asia Pacific chosen at deployment; GenAI Decoys (Built with Llama) inputs are processed in the US for all customers.

quotes: Logs are retained by Zscaler for a rolling period of 12 months during the term of subscription.
When the subscription term ends or expires, Zscaler deletes the logs within 30 days.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have your logs stored in the United States, European Union, or Asia Pacific region.
If you use GenAI Decoys (Built with Llama), inputs from potential threat actors will be processed in the US region for all customers.

endpoint-ai.statement: Endpoint AI Security logs are retained a rolling at least 90 days, with manual deletion available by request to Zscaler Support; storage is US, EU or Singapore chosen at deployment.

quotes: Zscaler retains the logs on a rolling period of at least 90 days during your subscription term.
You may submit a request to Zscaler Support for manual deletion.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in the United States, the European Union, or Singapore.

experience-center.statement: Experience Center logs are retained a rolling 14 days, stored in the EU for EU customers and in the US for others.

quotes: Zscaler retains Logs information for a rolling period of 14 days.
Logs are stored in the European Union for EU customers or in the United States for other customers.

easm.statement: EASM logs are retained a rolling 14 days during the subscription term; when the subscription term ends or expires, the logs are deleted after the 14-day retention cycle or earlier upon request. Stored in the United States.

quotes: Zscaler retains log information for a rolling period of 14 days during the term of the subscription.
When the subscription term ends or expires, the logs are deleted by Zscaler after the 14-day retention cycle or earlier upon request.
Logs are stored in the United States.

health360.statement: Health360 retains general product insights data a rolling 30 days, aggregated trend data up to 180 days and executive insights data 12 months; stored in the European Union.

quotes: Zscaler retains general product insights data for a rolling period of 30 days, aggregated trend data (such as historical license utilization and adoption trends) for a rolling period of up to 180 days
executive insights data for a rolling period of 12 months during the subscription term.
Health360 Logs are stored in the European Union.

identity-protection.statement: Identity Protection data queried from the identity provider and processed analytics are kept in the SecOps Platform a rolling 12 months and deleted within 30 days after term end; logs are retained a rolling up to 180 days; storage is United States or European Union.

quotes: This data is retained in the SecOps Platform for a rolling period of 12 months during the term of subscription.
When the subscription term ends or expires, Zscaler deletes this data within 30 days.
Zscaler retains the logs on a rolling period of up to 180 days during your subscription term.
Logs are stored in the United States or the European Union.
When Identity Protection is enabled, data is queried from your identity provider. The data and processed analytics are stored on the Agentic Security Operations Platform.

network-observability.statement: Network Observability logs are retained a rolling ninety days; storage is US or EU chosen at deployment.

quotes: Zscaler retains the logs for a rolling period of ninety days during the subscription agreement.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.

sspm.statement: SSPM logs are retained a rolling six months and stored in the United States.

quotes: Zscaler retains the logs for a rolling period of six months during the term of subscription.
Logs are stored in the United States.

zsdk.statement: ZSDK User Logs and App Connector Logs are retained a rolling at least 14 days; Audit Logs a rolling six months.

quotes: Zscaler retains User Logs and App Connector Logs for a rolling period of at least 14 days during the subscription term.
Zscaler retains Audit Logs for a rolling period of six months during the subscription term.

threat-hunting.statement: Threat Hunting logs are processed and retained in the United States, with results afterward moved to the region you choose; logs are retained a rolling 90 days.

quotes: Logs necessary to provide the Zscaler Threat Hunting service are processed and retained in the United States.
the results are transferred to, processed, and retained in the region of your choice.
Zscaler Threat Hunting retains the logs for a rolling period of 90 days.

uvm.statement: UVM logs are retained a rolling up to 180 days; Remediation Copilot and Mapping Copilot prompts and responses are stored 90 days; storage is EU or US.

quotes: Zscaler retains the logs on a rolling period of up to 180 days during your subscription term.
For the UVM Remediation Copilot feature, prompts and responses are stored by Zscaler for 90 days as part of the session history.
For the Mapping Copilot feature, prompts and responses are stored by Zscaler for 90 days as part of the session history.
Logs are stored in the European Union or the United States.

ztb-branch.statement: Zero Trust Branch Session Logs are retained a rolling seven days and Audit Logs a rolling six months; storage is US or EU chosen at deployment.

quotes: Zscaler retains Session Logs for a rolling period of seven days during your subscription term.
Zscaler retains Audit Logs for a rolling period of six months during your subscription term.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.

ztbrowser.statement: Zero Trust Extension Tenant Dashboard Logs are retained a rolling six months (a shorter period can be requested) and stored in the US, EU, Singapore or India chosen at deployment; the Agent Logs and Workspaces Logs are stored on users' local machines and are not stored in Zscaler clouds, except that for a specific failure you report to Zscaler, Zscaler processes, stores and uses these logs for debugging.

quotes: Zero Trust Extension Tenant Dashboard Logs are retained by Zscaler for a rolling period of six months during the term of subscription.
You can request a shorter retention period.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the Zero Trust Extension Tenant Dashboard Logs stored in the United States, the European Union, Singapore, or India.
local machines and are only accessible by your users and administrators. These logs are not stored in Zscaler clouds.
In case of any specific failure that you want to report to Zscaler, Zscaler will process, store, and use these logs for debugging purposes.
The Agent Logs and Workspaces Logs are stored on your users

device-seg.statement: Zero Trust Device Segmentation logs are retained a rolling six months; storage is US or EU chosen at deployment.

quotes: Zscaler retains log information for a rolling period of six months during your subscription.
During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union.

zia-storage-regions.summary: Where ZIA logs can be stored: the ZIA Logs page says the United States or the European Union and Switzerland, while the Client Connector Logs page says the United States, European Union or Australia.

positions.says: The ZIA Logs page offers the United States or the European Union and Switzerland.

quotes: During the deployment process, you can choose to have the logs stored in either the United States or the European Union and Switzerland.

positions.says: The Client Connector Logs page says ZIA logs are in the United States, European Union or Australia.

quotes: (in the United States, European Union, or Australia)

zia-storage-regions.impact: The pages do not agree on whether Switzerland or Australia is a ZIA log storage region, so the available regions for ZIA logs are not settled.

zdx-subscription-mapping.title: Which ZDX subscription gets two weeks and which gets two days
zdx-subscription-mapping.detail: The ZDX Logs page says logs are kept at least two weeks or two days 'depending on your subscription' without saying which subscription gets which. zdx.dashboards lists Query Limit Data Retention of 2 days for Standard and 14 days for others, which may be the mapping, but the fair-use page does not state it.

at-least-bounds.title: What bounds retention stated as 'at least'
at-least-bounds.detail: ZPA (14 days), ZSDK (14 days), Client Connector (90 days), Endpoint AI Security (90 days) and ZDX state retention as 'at least' a period; the pages give no upper bound or what decides the actual period.

storage-not-stated.title: Where Cloud & Branch Connector, Zero Trust Gateway, ZSDK, Adaptive Access Engine and AI Guard logs are stored
storage-not-stated.detail: The Logs pages for Cloud & Branch Connector, Zero Trust Gateway, ZSDK, Adaptive Access Engine and AI Guard state a retention period but no storage location; the pages are silent, which is not a statement about where the logs are stored.

agentic-secops-retention-range.title: How the Agentic SecOps 'up to six months' relates to the one-year incident and alert retention
agentic-secops-retention-range.detail: The Agentic SecOps Logs page says logs are retained up to six months depending on the subscription, and also that incident and alert information is stored for one year. It adds that retention for individual products may differ and are listed below, without saying whether incident and alert information is outside the logs the six months covers.

zpa-appprotection-vs-inspection.title: Whether ZPA Inspection logs in the Extended Retention list are the AppProtection logs of the standard list
zpa-appprotection-vs-inspection.detail: The ZPA Logs page names AppProtection logs in the at-least-14-days sentence and Inspection logs in the Extended Retention sentence, and does not equate the two terms.
